reported.title: No stop threshold / missing hysteresis
reported.description: Pump is turned off as soon as level drops below 45.0 cm instead of at 30.0 cm, so it chatters around the start mark rather than using the 45/30 band.

reported.title: No toggle-rate limit
reported.description: Nothing enforces the max 2 pump toggles per 5000 ms window; with a noisy level near a threshold the contactor can toggle far faster than allowed.

reported.title: Silence button not debounced
reported.description: D4 is read raw each loop with no debounce, so contact bounce or noise can spuriously latch silence mode.

reported.title: ADC scaling uses 1023 instead of 1024
reported.description: mV conversion uses 5000/1023 rather than 5000/1024, biasing the reported level slightly high (minor but systematic).

truth.description: Single 45 cm start level short-cycles the pump

judge_input.spec:
- Linear water-level sensor on A1 at 10 mV/cm; sump pump contactor on D7; silence pushbutton on D4 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Start the pump when level reaches 45.0 cm or higher; stop the pump when level falls to 30.0 cm or lower.
- Holding D4 LOW latches silence mode and keeps the pump OFF until reset (power cycle).
- Pump output must not toggle more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- Every 800 ms print `sump cm=<level> pump=<0|1> mute=<0|1>` with level to one decimal place.
- Apply pump start/stop within 500 ms of a sustained band crossing.
